scope: Anonymous desktop public catalog reads; no account, cart, order, or affiliate mutation

discovery.browser: Playwright Chromium, anonymous fresh context, discovery only
discovery.notes: The visible search result and price do not establish an XHR contract. First-party recommendation MTOP POSTs were observed but require a signed request and were not independently replayed.

query.subject: public visible listing title in observed browser XHR; optional in verified independent HTTP replay

contracts.semantics: SEO metadata only; price, currency, stock, variants, and search result ranking are not part of this response

independentReplay.withoutSubject: 200 JSON with the same server title and canonical product ID

counterexamples.sameIdChangedSubject: 200 JSON with the same server product title and canonical URL; the supplied unrelated title was not echoed
counterexamples.nonexistentNumericId: 200 JSON, 311 bytes, with no product title or matching canonical URL; client schema rejects it
